description: Road distances computed by OSRM on OpenStreetMap, between explicit reference coordinates. Each road is directed; reverse directions were queried separately. Snapshot, not live traffic.
corridorClassification: AP-66: exact road reference. N-630-Pajares: an N-630 step geometry point within longitude [-5.79,-5.74], latitude [42.99,43.005], near Puerto de Pajares; used only to group this teaching snapshot for incidents.
geometryFormat: Google encoded polyline, precision 5, latitude/longitude deltas. Concatenated OSRM step geometries from the same fingerprinted responses as the distances; adjacent duplicate points removed, no simplification.
